dataset_name: International E-Commerce Customer Analytics & Demographics (Messy Benchmark)

fields.customer_id: Unique customer identifier string (CUST-XXXX). Contains whitespace, lowercase, missing IDs.
fields.full_name: Customer first and last name. Contains titles, apostrophes (O'Connor), hyphens (Jean-Luc), casing anomalies.
fields.age: Customer age in years. Contains strings ('45 yrs'), negative numbers (-39), extreme outliers (195, 999), NaNs.
fields.country: Customer country of residence. Inconsistent naming ('USA', 'U.S.A.', 'US', 'Great Britain', 'UK').
fields.signup_date: Account creation timestamp. Mixed date formats (ISO, DD/MM/YYYY, MM-DD-YYYY, text 'yesterday', invalid '2023-02-30').
fields.annual_income: Estimated annual salary in USD. Dirty currencies ('$52,000', 'USD 75000', '75k', negative values, strings).
fields.purchase_amount: Recent transaction total in USD. Valid negative values (refunds/returns), extreme outliers, text ('Free', 'N/A').
fields.transaction_count: Lifetime transaction count. Numeric and string artifacts, negative counts, extreme outliers.
fields.email: Customer contact email. Missing '@' symbols, trailing spaces, uppercase, dummy placeholders.
fields.phone_number: Contact phone. High missingness (38% MCAR), multiple punctuation styles.
fields.satisfaction_score: Customer survey rating (1 to 5). Contains text ('Excellent', '5/5'), out-of-bounds numbers (-1, 10).
fields.churn: Binary churn label ('Yes' / 'No'). Stored inconsistently as 1/0, TRUE/FALSE, lowercase strings.
